name: matched-ks3-all-dense2816-direct-fp8
hypothesis: Encode only dense KS3 training inputs, projection weights and nonlinear outputs directly to FP8, omitting the preceding GS32 INT8 quantization. Keep coefficients GS32, FP16 nonlinearities, routed KS3 BF16/GS32, ANVIL and geometry learning rates, original delayed scales, cached dual layouts and all shared/model-wide settings. Validation remains the unchanged BF16/GS32 dense path; this intentional training-only precision ablation may reduce compounded quantization error. Require an independent direct-encoding output/gradient/cache oracle, original-mode regression oracle and paired100-update whole-model timing before convergence; do not claim isolated speed or validation improvement.
